# Aniket Dubey

> Full Stack Web Developer from Mumbai, India, specializing in responsive websites, web applications, and modern JavaScript frameworks. Builds with React, Firebase, PHP, MySQL, and WordPress.

Aniket Dubey is a Full Stack Web Developer based in Mumbai, India. He builds responsive websites, web applications, and full stack solutions using React, Firebase, PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and WordPress. He offers services including portfolio websites, business websites, landing pages, full stack web development, website redesigns, and WordPress development.
